title: Poison Ranged Animate Weapon Necromancer

stages.title: Act 3 (lvl 36 tree)
stages.goal: Improve your SRS links and use minion support gems.

stages.title: Act 4-10 (lvl 60 tree)
stages.goal: Keep SRS through Kitava. Level the swap gems separately.

stages.title: Entering maps: PrAW swap
stages.goal: Switch to Animate Weapon of Ranged Arms when you can generate blades and maintain summons.

stages.title: 100% Poison Transition
stages.goal: Get reliable minion poison chance and improve survivability.

stages.title: Covenant swap
stages.goal: Make the Covenant swap when you can handle its resource cost.

stages.title: Late: endgame wand + top Shaper shield
stages.goal: Invest in the wand and shield. Verify realistic minion count and Wither.

stages.title: Spell suppression: tree change, high budget
stages.goal: Reserve the suppression swap for when you can complete the gear package.

overview:
Start with Summon Raging Spirit. Get the transfigured gem and a source of blades before switching.

Source guide by Sleepy Cat: https://pobarchives.com/build/hCabR9KF
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/AFiSCdbB4KC4

PoB uses 3.29 simulation data. See the creator guide for assumptions and any additional stages.
